_comment: Copy to backup.json. Settings for scripts/backup.py: every vault -> its own zip -> a copy in every enabled destination. Point destinations at folders that a cloud client (Dropbox, Google Drive for desktop, OneDrive) already syncs.

vault_options._comment: encrypt: true encrypts that vault's archive with AES-256 (needs 7-Zip) using the password from the OBSIDIAN_BACKUP_PASSWORD environment variable. Off by default: a vault with encrypt: true and no password set is skipped.
